name: Shinkai-Labs Pvt. Ltd.
mission: An AI research and development company building systems for fields where reliability and accuracy decide outcomes for people: defense, healthcare and signal processing. From foundational research to deployed software.

products.name: Drone Detection and Monitoring System
products.body: Detects, tracks and classifies drones in real time by fusing radar, RF and electro-optical sensing, for fixed, mobile and portable deployments.

products.name: ANCIRS
products.body: An AI denoising communication system: acoustic signature analysis and noise cancellation so voice and signals stay clear around artillery fire. Being developed for the School of Artillery, Devlali, Nashik.

products.name: SAR and Signal Intelligence
products.body: Synthetic aperture radar image processing and radar signal analysis for surveillance and geospatial work.

products.name: RhythmNest
products.body: Fetal arrhythmia detection: isolates the fetal cardiac pattern from the maternal ECG to support early diagnosis.

products.name: WombChrono
products.body: Non-invasive fetal age estimation from the maternal ECG, using signal processing.

products.name: ScanSage
products.body: Medical image classification across MRI, CT and X-ray, with attention and geometric deep learning.

capabilities: Deep learning: optimal transport, Mamba, transformers
